description: Implementation of the TaxRateService interface, providing methods to manage TaxRate entities, such as listing by store, retrieving by code, and filtering by geographic and tax class attributes. This class interacts with the TaxRateDao for database operations and is annotated as a Spring service.

classes.name: TaxRateServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing tax rate management operations, extending generic entity service and integrating with DAO for database interactions.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a TaxRate object by its code within a given store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a TaxRate object by ID after fetching it from the database.
